sentences.en: We ordered the food in advance to avoid waiting.
sentences.zh: 我们提前点餐以免排队等候。

sentences.en: Please send the report in advance so we can review it beforehand.
sentences.zh: 请提前发送报告，这样我们可以事先审阅。

sentences.en: She booked her flight in advance to secure a good seat.
sentences.zh: 她提前订了机票以确保能获得一个好位置。
